en.bdb: The way leading to the adoption of beneficent wisdom of the Guru (Gurmat) is known as the Gurmukh-way.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: hukam rajaiee chalanaa gur sabadh veechaaree|

en.bdb: In it one is taught to live in the will of the Lord and to ponder upon the Word of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhaanaa bhaavai khasam kaa nihachau nira(n)kaaree|

en.bdb: The will of the Master comes to be loved and in all thoughts permeates the formless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਸਕ ਮੁਸਕ ਮਹਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: eisak musak mahakaar hai hui paraupakaaree|

en.bdb: As love and fragrance do not remain hidden, the Gurmukh also does not remain concealed and gets himself busy in altruistic activities.
He imbibes in him the faith, contentment, ecstasy, and the qualities of being skilful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜਿਣਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aap gavaiaa jin haumai maaree ||3||

en.bdb: Gurmukh decimates ego and conquers it.
